contract:
SHARED FILE (~13.6k lines): B19 (SCHOOL const :293, 'Organizations · IU' :8255, 'Officially recognized orgs at IU.' :8375, :13590) and post edit (desktop feed ⋯ menu near :5492) also edit it; F5c-2 follows on the same file. Never parallel. This batch also carries the never-shipped invites-spec B19-extended discover work, because the file is still on is_public.

- Org type (:101-116) gains optional join_policy?: JoinPolicy, audience?: OrgAudience, hidden?: boolean, campus_id?: string|null, follower_count?: number|null (from ?filter=mine at :465; that call and its meaning DO NOT CHANGE).
- DiscoverOrg (:122-139): replace is_public with join_policy, audience; add join_state, join_reason, pending_invite, viewer_follows?, follower_count? (never rendered on a card). DiscoverFilter (:141) = 'all'|'following'|'open'|'request'|'invite'.
- OrgsTabBody (:143-430): delete `pending`/`busy` maps (:145-146, :188-200) and handleJoin (:8211-8232); add overrides: Record<orgId, {state, following, role}>. Add two quiet loads next to discover: `/api/orgs?filter=following` (failure "Couldn't load the clubs you follow.") and `/api/me/org-invites` (failure "Couldn't load your invites."); OrgJoinControl onChange -> set override, then reload following + invites (discover keeps its rows and scroll). Filter predicate (:8236-8240): open/request/invite compare join_policy; 'following' switches the list to the following payload (client-side name match on debouncedQ).
- SceneHeader subtitle (:8257) -> 'Follow any club to get its posts. Join to get its chats.' (eyebrow is B19's).
- Groups (:8368-8413), when filter==='all' and no query: prepend DiscoverGroup title "You're invited" hint 'Accept to become a member and get the chats.' (invite rows) and DiscoverGroup title 'Yours' hint 'Clubs you follow or belong to.' (following rows minus invited ids); Verified / Student communities / Dormant exclude ids already shown. 'Student communities' hint (:8394) -> 'Groups created by verified students. Anyone can follow them.' A failed invites/following load renders that group's title with <LoadFailed tone='dark'> and Retry in place of its cards. Empty copy (:8358-8362): filter 'following' -> "You don't follow any clubs yet."; other filters -> `No ${label} clubs to discover yet.` with label Open / By request / Invite only; query -> `No clubs match “${q}”.`; all -> unchanged.
- DiscoverFilterChips (:9030-9085): 'All' · 'Following' · 'Open' · 'By request' (lock) · 'Invite only' (lock).
- DiscoverGroup (:8882-9028) props: drop pending/busy/onJoin, add overrides + onChange.
- DiscoverCard (:9087+): view = orgRowView(relation, 'card'). Label logic (:9105-9112) and the join button (:9298-9325) replaced by <OrgJoinControl variant='card' source='discover'> inside a wrapper with onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} (the card itself opens the preview). Name line gets view.chip. Meta (:9222-9234): '@handle' · view.meta (lock icon before 'By request'/'Invite only') · memberCountText. NO follower count on any card (§5.3). view.disclosure renders under the controls, 12px muted.
- OrgQuickViewModal (:8432+): ctaLabel/ctaDisabled (:8447-8454) and the CTA block (:8740-8778) replaced by the same card control + disclosure; meta Private/Public (:8610-8616) -> view.meta + chip; 'View page' link kept.
- ChannelRail header chip (:12105-12112): `${policyChip(org.join_policy)} · ${channels.length} channels` (lock icon for By request / Invite only; policy part omitted if join_policy missing; prefix 'Hidden · ' when org.hidden); the loadErr no-count rule stays.
- Search dropdown (:3922-3936): role string appends ' · Invite only' / ' · By request' and ' · IU only' / ' · Purdue only' when the search payload carries join_policy/audience (it does not today, search/route.ts:203-206); action stays 'View'. SearchOrg type (:3543-3552) gains optional join_policy, audience.
- EmptyState (:13589-13591) copy -> 'Follow any club to get its posts. Join to get its chats.'
acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint count not above HEAD.
`grep -n "filter=mine" src/app/campus/campus-home.tsx` returns exactly the two pre-existing lines (:465 rail, :6997 eligible orgs) with unchanged code; rail screenshot identical before/after.

`grep -n "is_public" src/app/campus/campus-home.tsx` hits only the create form, the settings overview/read-only rows and the tab rule (removed in F5c-2) and the SearchOrg/FeedOrg/MapOrg type declarations; none in OrgsTabBody, DiscoverCard, OrgQuickViewModal or ChannelRail.
`grep -n "follower_count" src/app/campus/campus-home.tsx` has no hit inside DiscoverCard or OrgQuickViewModal.

1280px, production data, non-member test account: SAE card shows 'Follow' (not 'Request to join'), meta '@sae · Invite only · 1 member', disclosure line; quick view identical controls; filter chip 'Invite only' keeps SAE, 'Open' shows the empty copy.

1280px with overrides: 'You're invited' and 'Yours' groups above Verified; an open club card shows 'Follow' + 'Join'; a request club followed shows 'Following ✓' + 'Request to join'; a following-load failure shows LoadFailed in the Yours group only. As the SAE owner, the rail chip reads 'Invite only · 4 channels'.
